description: FHIR R4 PractitionerRole resource — a specific set of Roles/Locations/specialties/services that a practitioner may perform at an organization for a period of time.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: Business Identifiers that are specific to a role/location.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Whether this practitioner role record is in active use.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: The period during which the person is authorized to act as a practitioner in these role(s) for the organization.

fields.label: Practitioner
fields.description: Practitioner that is able to provide the defined services for the organization.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: The organization where the Practitioner performs the roles associated.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Roles which this practitioner is authorized to perform for the organization. e.g. doctor | nurse | pharmacist.

fields.label: Specialty
fields.description: Specific specialty of the practitioner. e.g. General practice, Internal medicine, Pediatrics.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: The location(s) at which this practitioner provides care.

fields.label: Telecom
fields.description: Contact details that are specific to the role/location/service.

fields.label: Available Time
fields.description: A collection of times the practitioner is available or performing this role at the location and/or healthcareservice.
